meta.name: Elpidio
meta.tagline: Computer science is one of my greatest passions: it always brings new challenges, and it never gets boring.

paragraphs: Born in 1997 and based in Ravello (SA), Italy. I'm a full-stack developer who is always ready to take on new challenges and keep growing, with a particular focus on the web.
Since 2022 I have been building enterprise applications with Java, Spring, TypeScript and Angular; today I develop CRM, KPI and IoT solutions from backend to frontend.
My mission is to make people's lives simpler through software.

experiences.title: Full-stack Developer
experiences.description: I build custom CRM and KPI applications for clients across backend and frontend, with a strong focus on smart IoT solutions that let heterogeneous devices communicate.
highlights: Custom CRM and KPI applications for clients
End-to-end development, from backend to frontend
